appSettings.title: Settings
appSettings.intro: Your profile, sign-in security and privacy choices. Everything here applies only to your own account.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.signedOut: You are signed out. Sign in and try again.
errors.notConfigured: Email is not available right now. Please try again later.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
errors.invalid: Some of the details are not valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.name: Enter your name (up to 100 characters).
errors.dob: Enter a valid date of birth. Members must be 18 or older.
errors.pin: Enter a six-digit Indian PIN code, or leave it blank.
errors.retirementAge: Expected retirement age must be between 40 and 80.
errors.riskIncomplete: Answer all five questions to get your risk profile.
errors.noPassword: This account signs in without a password.
errors.wrongPassword: The current password is not correct.
errors.samePassword: Choose a password different from the current one.

password.breached: This password has appeared in a known data breach. Choose a different one.

errors.passkeyName: Enter a name for the passkey (up to 100 characters).
errors.confirmRequired: Tick the box to confirm you want to delete the account.
errors.mailFailed: The confirmation email could not be sent. Please try again later.

profile.name: Full name
profile.preferredNameHint: How we greet you. Leave blank to use your first name.
profile.dobHint: Used for retirement and insurance sizing. Never shown to anyone else.
profile.cityTierHint: Tier 1 is a metro such as Chennai or Mumbai; tier 3 is a small town. It adjusts cost-of-living benchmarks.
profile.languageHint: Changing this switches the whole app, including emails we send you.
profile.retirementAgeHint: Between 40 and 80. Leave blank to use 60.
profile.healthHint: Optional, yes or no only. Used to size life and health cover; never shared.
profile.smoker: Do you smoke or use tobacco?
profile.languageChanged: Display language updated. The app now shows in your chosen language.

states.DH: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

risk.title: Risk tolerance
risk.intro: Five quick questions. Your answers set how much of your long-term money the plan suggests keeping in growth assets such as equity.

explain.conservative: Capital safety first: the plan leans on debt, deposits and a smaller equity share.
explain.balanced: A middle path: a mix of equity and debt that can ride out normal market swings.
explain.growth: Comfortable with volatility for higher long-term returns: a larger equity share for goals more than seven years away.

horizon.text: When will you need most of the money you are investing?

drop.text: Your investments fall 20% in a month. What do you do?
drop.a3: Invest more while prices are low

experience.text: How much have you invested in equity (shares or equity funds) so far?
experience.a1: Nothing, or only fixed deposits and gold
experience.a2: Some, through SIPs or a few funds
experience.a3: A lot; I follow the markets regularly

income.text: How steady is your household income?
income.a1: Irregular, or one earner with no buffer
income.a2: Steady, with a few months of savings
income.a3: Very steady, with more than six months of expenses saved

priority.a1: Never losing money, even if growth is slow
priority.a2: Beating inflation with moderate ups and downs
priority.a3: The highest growth, accepting big swings along the way

security.verifyHint: Confirm your email so you can recover the account and receive reminders.
security.passwordIntro: Changing your password signs out every other device.
security.newPasswordHint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence you will remember works well.
security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
security.noPassword: This account uses passkeys only, so there is no password to change.
security.sessionsIntro: Sessions end after 30 minutes idle or 30 days at most. Sign out anything you do not recognise.
security.signedOutElsewhere: Every other device has been signed out.
security.passkeysIntro: Sign in with Face ID, fingerprint or a security key instead of a password. Keep at least one way to sign in that you can still use if you lose a device.

privacy.consentsIntro: Each choice is recorded with its date so you can always see what you agreed to. Nothing is sold, and no advertising is based on your finances.

analytics.label: Anonymous usage analytics
analytics.hint: Which pages and features are used, without any financial figures.

marketing.label: Weekly digest and product updates by email
marketing.hint: You can also unsubscribe from any email.

peerComparison.label: Peer comparison
peerComparison.hint: Show how your score compares with similar households; your data joins the anonymous benchmark.

personalisation.label: Personalised content
personalisation.hint: Suggest articles and lessons based on your check-up results.

privacy.exportIntro: Get everything we hold about you: profile, household members, financial items, goals, check-ups, plan progress and consent history.
privacy.exportNote: The files contain your full financial details in plain text. Store them somewhere safe.
privacy.deleteIntro: We email you a confirmation link. Once confirmed, your account is locked and permanently erased after {days} days. You can cancel from this page until then.
privacy.deleteConfirm: I understand that my household data, goals and check-ups will be permanently deleted.
privacy.deletionEmailSent: Check your inbox for the confirmation link. It works for 24 hours.
privacy.deletionPending: Deletion is confirmed. Your account and all its data are permanently removed on {when}.
